XY series · PR-XY

XY Black Star Promos

Released October 12, 2013 · 216 cards

Expanded

XY Black Star Promos is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the XY series, released in English on October 12, 2013. Its main set has 211 cards, plus 5 secret rares numbered beyond the set (216 in total). It includes 194 Pokémon, 22 Trainer and 0 Energy cards, and is legal in the Expanded format (rotated out of Standard).

Illustrators

37 illustrators worked on XY Black Star Promos. Most cards: 5ban Graphics (65), Eske Yoshinob (17), Naoki Saito (12), Ryo Ueda (10), Ken Sugimori (9), Mitsuhiro Arita (8), PLANETA (7), kawayoo (6).
